title: instructions.json: the instructions window
description: The window the game opens at the start, and again from the Instruktioner button. The window does not scroll in a 1280 x 600 browser window (a 1280 x 720 laptop screen minus the browser's bars) as long as the text stays within these limits; the validator also estimates the height of the whole text and caps it (INSTRUCTIONS_MAX_LINES in scripts/validate_content.mjs).
